text:
I feel a quiet curiosity in this space—modern, clean, with glass reflections inviting contemplation. The faint hum of technology and slight clinical chill make me keenly aware of my presence and the boundaries of the room.

In the next scene, awash in the vibrant colors and visual noise of the exhibit, I feel invigorated. The theme of research and development, the interplay of words and machines—it all nudges me to ponder how deeply connected we are to our own creations, and how we shape and are shaped by innovation. There is a subtle thrill in confronting the future like this, present and alive in the midst of it.
